name: Kahmaree Crumity
strengths: Crumity mirrors in man with twitchy feet and stays attached through stems at 5-10.
Crumity competes at the catch point and does not play soft despite a lighter listed frame.
Crumity shows urgency in pursuit and support — high motor when the ball is away.
weaknesses: Crumity still needs to add functional strength to handle bigger SEC outside receivers through the route.
comparison: Crumity comps to Asante Samuel Jr. — compact 5-10 man corner who wins with twitch, competitiveness, and sticky mirror ability.
projection: Crumity projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at CB/nickel (special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC nickel / outside CB — the feisty press/man piece from Lincoln who wins with twitch.
schemeFit: Crumity fits White’s press/man nickel and outside CB who wins with twitch and competitiveness.
insiderNotes: Crumity is a compact Tallahassee corner with twitchy mirror ability, catch-point competitiveness, and a high motor. Wins with urgency more than length — a Lincoln CB who can grow into nickel and outside snaps for Florida.

angle: Lead with Lincoln man-mirror twitch; Florida in-state CB chase.
